title: Lead task closes in the main checkout ship through task publish
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: lead ran `krn task close t-gc828jq --as done` in the main checkout after PR #1404 proved it; the close rewrote tasks/t-gc828jq.json in the working tree, `krn task publish` shipped only the created record t-wc54000 (2a98686) because publish reads refs/krn/pending-tasks (src/cli/task-publish.ts:42), and the main checkout was left dirty so `git pull` failed.
Outcome: a lead close (or release/ready) in the main checkout goes to the pending ref like create does, leaves the main checkout clean, and `krn task publish` ships it.
Proof: a task-publish test: close a published record in a main checkout -> working tree clean, publish --dry-run lists that record.
